facts.text: The user answered multiple choice questions about the Ethereum Shanghai Upgrade.
The user asked what the Ethereum Shanghai Upgrade is.
The user asked which EIPs are planned to be implemented with the Ethereum Shanghai upgrade, including EIP-3860, EIP-3845, EIP-3651, and EIP-3855.
The user asked which EIP brings a new instruction for the EVM that helps shrink the size of smart contracts and optimizes the contract code.
The user asked what the expected date for the launch of the Ethereum Shanghai Upgrade is, with options including March 2023, December 2023, March 2022, and February 2023.

The user asked what long-term stakers and HODLers can do after the launch of the Ethereum Shanghai Upgrade, with options including enjoying extra liquidity and withdrawing ETH after more than two years.
